ddos.presetActiveHint: Current profile: {name}. Click Save if you changed other fields.
ddos.presetCustomHint: Values do not match Relaxed / Balanced / Strict — treated as Custom.
ddos.presetUnsavedHint: Form shows {form}; server still has {saved}. Click Save policy to apply.
ddos.policySaved: Protection policy saved. Rate limiters reloaded.
ddos.confirmReset: Reset all DDoS policy fields to .env defaults?
ddos.proxyHint: When traffic passes through nginx or Cloudflare, enable trust hops so bans, rate limits, and audit logs use the real client IP — not the proxy IP.
ddos.proxyTrustHopsHint: 0 = direct only (ignore headers). 1 = nginx or Cloudflare→app. 2 = Cloudflare→nginx→app.
ddos.proxyIpSourceHint: auto tries CF-Connecting-IP, then X-Real-IP, then X-Forwarded-For. Use “socket” only for direct connections.
ddos.trustedProxiesHint: Only these peers may set CF-Connecting-IP / X-Real-IP / XFF. Default 127.0.0.1 — add your nginx/LB host if remote. Direct clients cannot spoof headers.
ddos.whitelistHint: One IP or CIDR per line. These IPs are never auto-banned.

pm2.title: PM2 control
pm2.confirmClearLogs: Clear PM2 and ysk-omni log files? This cannot be undone (files are truncated).
pm2.logsAutoTrim: Auto-trim over {maxMb} MB → keep last ~{keepKb} KB (on each log read).
pm2.confirmRestart: Restart under PM2? Port will be handed over cleanly.
pm2.portHint: HTTP port for the gateway Admin UI and API. Changing the port updates .env and restarts the runner so the new port takes effect.
pm2.confirmPortChange: Change listen port to {port} and restart the gateway? You will need to open Admin on the new port (e.g. http://localhost:{port}/admin).
pm2.portSavedNeedRestart: Port {port} saved to .env. Restart the gateway for it to take effect.
pm2.portAfterRestart: After restart, open Admin at http://localhost:{port}/admin
pm2.hint: Run with PM2 or detached ysk-omni. Switch anytime here or via CLI.
pm2.switchHint: Only one runner should bind the port.
pm2.confirmSwitchPm2: Switch to PM2? Gateway restarts under PM2 in a few seconds.
pm2.confirmSwitchGctoac: Switch to ysk-omni? Gateway restarts as a detached process in a few seconds.
pm2.switchScheduled: Switch scheduled. Admin will refresh automatically in about 10 seconds.
pm2.autoRefreshIn: This page will reload automatically in {n} seconds…
pm2.configHint: Saved to pm2.runtime.json and applied via ecosystem.config.cjs. Save & apply restarts PM2 if it is the active runner.
pm2.msgBinaryMissing: pm2 not found on PATH. Install: npm install -g pm2
pm2.msgNotInList: App "{app}" is not in the PM2 list — use Start with PM2 or Switch to PM2.
pm2.msgPortGctoac: Port {port} is held by ysk-omni (pid {pid}). Use “Switch to PM2” to hand over.
pm2.msgErrored: PM2 process errored — check logs / config, then Restart or fix port conflicts.
pm2.msgBothRunners: Both runners detected; ysk-omni pid {pid} also holds resources. Prefer one via Switch.
pm2.msgSwitchPm2: Switching to PM2… The gateway will restart under PM2 in a few seconds.
pm2.msgSwitchGctoac: Switching to ysk-omni… The gateway will restart as a detached process in a few seconds.

support.title: সহায়তা
support.subtitle: Creator, sponsors, and YSK Limited — free product, real help
support.creatorBody: This OpenAI-compatible gateway is a free open-source product for running local models as an API. The project is maintained in the open; your feedback and bug reports matter.
support.sponsorBody: If this gateway saves you time, consider sponsoring development. Every bit helps keep it free for everyone.
support.walletsHint: Send only on the matching network. Double-check the address before you transfer.
support.yskBody: Need hands-on help beyond the free Admin panel? YSK Limited can provide:
support.yskLi1: Server install, hardening, and day-to-day ops
support.yskPrice: No public price list — email us and we will scope it to your setup.
support.helpBody: Email with OS, install / log path, and expected vs actual result. Every message is read.
support.docs: Full docs are in the repo README

business.title: ব্যবসা

business.deployBody: Run YSK Omni on your own hardware or private cloud, with the same Admin and OpenAI-compatible API.

business.deployLi4: Ops: queue, DDoS, reverse proxy, and PM2
business.oemBody: Embed the gateway in your product. Keep your brand on the Admin panel and client surfaces.
business.oemLi1: Ship local inference inside your own product
business.integrateBody: Connect existing accounts, pipelines, and monitoring to the gateway without rewriting clients.
business.integrateLi3: Image, video, speech, and transcription pipelines
business.partnerBody: Resellers and regional teams who introduce YSK Omni with their own stack.
business.contactBody: No public price list — email us and we will scope it to your environment.
